note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor (authored none of the userns spec commits d8427e4380, b00e3c6710, 68b723ec4f, 7d11a51269). userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-executes the one test in a new user+net+mount namespace and returns false in the parent only after the child's own PASS line; a child failure, a zero-exit failure or a child that selected nothing fails the parent, and a child skip skips it, so the guard cannot turn a red into a green. Section 2: "The remaining bits of the flags field are reserved for future use.  They MUST be set to zero by clients and ignored by servers and relay agents." Both client units changed only by the guard and the build tag (integration dropped); sfSetupLab and the assertions are unchanged. TestRFC2131ClientSetsReservedFlagsBitsToZero reads the real client's DISCOVER (positive, bits 1-15 zero) and, after an OFFER with flags 0xffff, the REQUEST with the same xid (negative, bits 1-15 zero). TestRFC2131ClientRenewalSetsReservedFlagsBitsToZero binds from an ACK with flags 0xffff, identifies the renewing REQUEST by ciaddr == the bound address, and asserts bits 1-15 zero. Server side unchanged: TestFlagsReservedBitsIgnored (flags 0 vs 0x7fff, reply unicast to yiaddr:68 either way). Every clause covered on both producer paths; records against clearReservedFlags, v4ExtendRequest and responseAddr are panic reverts, current per the gate.
